notes: Single panel. Depot (60'/50') down the left side (the strip west of it overlaps sheet 466); the C.H.&D. R.R. yard runs north-south through x about 1300-2300. Gest (60') and W. 8th (80', on an iron bridge over the tracks) cross the whole sheet; South (50') runs from Depot to the yard and again from the yard east past Evans (not drawn across the tracks). Summer and Berlin (50') run from Gest (both continue north on 496) and end at South. Erie and Whateley (40') run from the tracks to Evans and end there (sheet 468 shows no Erie or Whateley east of Evans). Evans (60') down the right edge; the right margin from x about 6400 is curled into the binding, so Evans' east face is compressed there and the Evans points lean on the west face and the water pipe. The 'LUMBER DRIVEWAY' between Summer and Berlin is private and ignored. 'CINCINNATI & HAMMOND SPRING CO.' and 'The CINCINNATI TRACTION COMPANY' printed along Summer and Depot are firm names, not streets. The strip below 8th (y > 7000) is printed note boxes over sheets 462/463, no streets.
